name: American Express
account_opened_hint: Log in, open the card, then Account Services → Card Details. Do not use the "Member Since" year printed on the card — that is when you first became an Amex customer, not when this card was opened, and Amex routinely backdated it before 2015.

name: Chase
account_opened_hint: Log in, open the card, then Account details on the web or the ⋯ menu → Account details in the app. It is also on the first page of any statement PDF.

name: Capital One
account_opened_hint: Log in, open the card, then Account Details, or I Want To → View Account Details. It also appears on the first page of a statement.

name: Citi
account_opened_hint: Log in, open the card, then Account Details. It is also in the summary on the first page of a statement.

name: U.S. Bank
account_opened_hint: Log in, open the card, then Account Options → Account Details, or check the first page of a monthly statement.

name: Bank of America
account_opened_hint: Log in, open the card, then the Information & Services tab. It is also on the first page of a statement.
